return_to_home_precision.justification: The return-to-home L2 error is 0.0014 rad, well below the 0.003 rad threshold. This demonstrates excellent precision in resetting to the initial configuration, ensuring the system is ready for repeatable operation.

cw_step_consistency.justification: Joint drift during CW strokes reached 0.4297 rad (exceeding the 0.1 rad limit), indicating significant inconsistency in wrist positioning. Additionally, the CW stroke duration CoV of 36.6% further highlights irregular motion, affecting torque delivery and cycle reliability.
